$description: Halden Group sample client theme: the brand variables that tokens with `overridableBy` read. The token build checks every contrast pair again with these values and exports them as `clientThemes.halden` in src/styles/tokens.generated.ts. The app (CLIENT_THEME in src/app/App.tsx) and Storybook (CLIENT in .storybook/preview.tsx) still keep their own copies; keep the three equal until both import the generated object.
